text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they learn from unfair data, which may lead to unfair treatment of certain groups. Fairness means making sure AI treats everyone equally. Privacy is also a key concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. People should know how their data is used. Transparency matters too: we need to understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must follow clear rules. They should test systems carefully and think about the social impact. By focusing on these values, we can build AI that benefits everyone and avoids harm.
